name: Клип под свой трек
about: Три сцены со сменой плана, ваш трек вместо звука сцен, 1080p и 48 fps.

data.title: Сцена 1
data.text:
Stylish music video look, saturated colour, high contrast, light haze, dynamic lighting.

Scene: an empty warehouse with coloured spotlights; an adult woman, about 25, in a silver jacket, dances alone.

Camera: full-body shot, the camera slowly orbits her.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She spins with her arms open.
[3s-5s] She stops and looks into the camera.

Audio: footsteps on concrete, no music.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Сцена 2
data.text:
Stylish music video look, saturated colour, high contrast, light haze, dynamic lighting.

Scene: a rooftop at night with city lights; the same woman in the silver jacket dances in the wind.

Camera: medium shot, handheld, slightly shaky.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She throws her head back and laughs.
[3s-5s] She jumps and lands with a spin.

Audio: wind, no music.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

data.title: Сцена 3
data.text:
Stylish music video look, saturated colour, high contrast, light haze, dynamic lighting.

Scene: a neon-lit tunnel; the same woman in the silver jacket walks toward the camera.

Camera: medium shot, the camera tracks backward in front of her.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She walks toward the camera with confidence.
[3s-5s] She raises one hand to the lens.

Audio: echoing footsteps, no music.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

Клип под свой трек.

Загрузите музыку в узел «Трек». Сцены — новые, со сменой плана, без музыки внутри («no music» в звуке), звук сцен в «Музыке» выключен — слышен только трек. Выход — 1080p и 48 кадров в секунду.
